Description: Original simulator rates: drought 5 %/day, pests 8 %/day, price shocks 10 %/day (time-varying around these means); observed mean events/season: drought 1.5, pest 2.3, shocks 3.0
Drought-prone season: drought base rate tripled to 15 %/day; observed mean events/season: drought 4.5, pest 2.3, shocks 3.0
Pest-pressure season: outbreak base rate raised to 20 %/day; observed mean events/season: drought 1.5, pest 6.2, shocks 3.0
Combined stress: drought 15 %/day and pests 20 %/day; observed mean events/season: drought 4.5, pest 6.2, shocks 3.0
Same exogenous draws as baseline; own sales depress the received price
